📜 OUR STORY (EST. 1977)

Founded in 1977 • Owned by Cliff Since 1982

Dr. No's was founded back in 1977. Cliff and Ward took over the store in 1982, and the rest, as they say, is history. Currently, the store is solely owned by Cliff, who has as much enthusiasm for comics today as he did when he was growing up and creating his own fanzines (look that one up kids.)

💡 47+ Years of Dedication to Comic Culture & Community
⭐ LARGEST COLLECTION IN THE SOUTH

Cobb County's Premier Comic & Gaming SuperStore

In our time, we have carried a little bit of everything before deciding to focus on the comics and games side of things. We are currently the largest comics and games store in Cobb County and have the largest trade paperback collection in the south.

100k+ Back Issues Largest TPB Library Full Gaming Arena
THE DOCTOR NO'S CREW

MEET OUR PASSIONATE TEAM

CLIFF

Owner of Dr. No's Comics and Games

Owner of Dr. No's Comics and Games, Cliff can be elusive to find at the store at times, but he is always pleasant when found. His knowledge of the comics industry is amazing, and his ability to multi-task is second to none.

✉️ Contact Cliff ➔

BUCK

Store Manager & Games Manager

Store Manager and Games Manager of Dr. NO's. Buck is the vivacious, entertaining, aide-in-arms to the store. He is the master of the special order, and goes to great lengths to ensure that customers get what they deserve--in a good way.

✉️ Contact Buck ➔

IZZY

Comics Manager

Comics Manager of Dr. No's. Inexplicably friendly and reclusive, soft-spoken Izzy has a passion for indie comics, reptiles, tattoos and cool hair. Super helpful when you need to find something a little different, and maybe just a bit creepy, Izzy is the one to help!

TOM

Weekend Manager

Weekend Manager of Dr. No's. Action figure movie director. Movie nut. Has a different view of the world at large. Master of Magic: the Gathering and avid collector of... just about every card game imaginable. Tom also has an eclectic taste in his comics so he can help a customer find the out of the way titles.

JAIR

GSU Graduate & Comic Reviewer

Jair is a GSU graduate, veteran sandwich artist, and aspiring writer. Feel free to ask him about the X-Men or his anime car sometime. Jair's Comic Review helps folks understand maybe even appreciate something they haven't seen before! Jair believes all comics are good. They represent human expression, dreams put to a page through days, months, and years of dedication. They are windows into other worlds, aspirations of all we can be, warnings of what we may become and everything in between. Above all he believes that comics can help us understand the things we often don't consider.

SHELLEY

Former Comic Shop Owner & Specialist

Shelley has many years of experience in comics, including almost a decade as owner of her own comic shop, Teahouse Comics. We were thrilled to have her bring her expertise to our team. Her enthusiasm for comics of all sorts, from superheroes to manga to indy to experimental, comes through in every conversation.

💰 TIMELY ORDER DISCOUNTS
  • 📌 15 Items Minimum: There must be at least 15 items ordered in a month to qualify for a discount.
  • 💳 Prepayment Required: Orders must be paid in full to activate. Items will not be pulled unless paid beforehand!
  • ⚡ 10% Discount: Order must be paid in full by the 22nd of that order month.
  • ⏳ 5% Discount: Order must be paid in full by the 15th of the following month.
  • 📦 Weekend Processing: Orders placed on Saturday or Sunday are processed the following Monday.
✉️ MAIL ORDERS & PAYMENTS

Dr. No's ships anywhere within the United States ($12.50 to $18 minimum shipping fee). Mail order payments accepted: Personal Check or Money Order (or PayPal by advance consultation).
